memoryMetric: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true), all managed threads, per completed job; cumulative allocation metric only, not live/RSS or admission policy
boundary: Host creation, seeded source, execution/result cleanup; fresh lane also compiles entry. Local nonquiet diagnostic; no forced GC, no CPython timing.
freshLane: New entry compilation plus fresh execution and local-module preparation each invocation
warmLane: Reused compiled entry; fresh execution and local-module preparation each invocation
controls: No-import sum(range(64))+3 with otherwise equal host setup
initialCandidate: Preserved initial-candidate-after.json and initial-candidate.patch; these precede the namespace correctness fix and do not describe the final patch
